name: Literal Clock
description: A word clock screensaver: a grid of letters where the words that tell the time light up, with four corner dots for the minutes in between. In English, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Spanish and Simplified Chinese.
author: missing-foss

settings.title: Language
settings.description: The language the time is spelled in.

settings.title: Quarter hours
settings.default: viertel nach drei, viertel vor vier
options: viertel nach drei, viertel vor vier
settings.description: How the German clock says a quarter past and a quarter to.

settings.title: Midday and midnight
settings.description: How the Italian clock says twelve o'clock.

settings.title: On the hour
settings.description: Whether the Spanish clock adds EN PUNTO on the hour.

settings.title: Quarters and five to
settings.description: 一刻 and 三刻, or 四十五分 at a quarter to, or 差五分 at five to the hour.

settings.title: Lit letters
settings.description: The letters that tell the time, and the lit corner dots.

settings.title: Unlit letters
settings.description: Every other letter, and the unlit corner dots.

settings.title: Minute dots
settings.description: One corner dot for each minute past the five-minute step, clockwise from top left.

settings.title: Size
settings.description: How much of the screen the clock fills.

settings.title: Slow drift
settings.description: Moves the clock a little each minute, round a small circle once an hour.
